description: deadmines.yaml on Claude Code with Sonnet 5.5: five brand-new level-1 Humans in Northshire, a dungeon party (a tank, a healer, three DPS), with one goal: clear the Deadmines (achievement 628, earned when Edwin VanCleef dies). Levelling and gear on the way are up to them. A week on the clock; each agent stops when it has the achievement.
